The main agent is the sole writer of `lead_router/router.py`. The public
`route_lead(Lead) -> str` interface and supplied source tests are preserved.

## Confirmed rules, in precedence order

1. If `existing_route` is not `None`, return it unchanged, even when the amount
   is negative or the region is missing. An empty existing string is preserved.
2. Otherwise, negative amounts raise `ValueError`.
3. Otherwise, `None`, empty, or whitespace-only regions route to `manual_review`,
   including leads at or above the senior threshold.
4. Otherwise, amounts at least 10,000 route to `senior`.
